title: Amazon worker fired shortly after disclosing pregnancy has discrimination claim, court rules
summary: The alleged close connection between her disclosure, restrictions on her overtime and her termination indicated adverse action based on the pregnancy, the court said.

title: Feds axe contractor affirmative action requirements in trio of final rules
summary: The documents follow up on one of President Donald Trump’s first orders that sought to alter the federal government’s antidiscrimination enforcement work.

title: Skilled labor demand is exploding. AI may be both a cause and a solution
summary: A survey by the National Fire Protection Association found that while AI is putting pressure on an already stretched fire and safety workforce, it is also making their jobs easier.

title: Women are significantly underrepresented in the AI workforce
summary: The gender disparity is even more pronounced in the highest-paying jobs and top executive levels, according to research from LinkedIn.

title: Managers say they are using public AI tools to prepare for hard conversations
summary: That use can include inputting employee names and performance details into a public artificial intelligence platform, a survey found.

title: Feds propose ‘Trump Account’ regulations as older workers’ retirement hopes dwindle
summary: Trump Accounts will help eligible children “enjoy years of compound earnings for their future college, retirement and other needs,” an IRS leader said.

title: This week in 5 numbers: Employees struggle to find time for upskilling
summary: Here’s a roundup of numbers from the last week — including how many consecutive business days Bank of America employees are allowed to work remotely.

title: More than a third of workers say their retirement age has moved later
summary: Employees’ reasons for delaying retirement included the cost of living, not earning enough and a lack of savings.

title: Gap between demand and hiring widens
summary: More candidates are applying for jobs in manufacturing especially, but companies aren’t successfully moving them into available roles, according to an ICIMS report.

title: Only 1 in 5 organizations are prepared to move toward autonomous AI agents, Deloitte finds
summary: Poorly documented or misunderstood processes, fragmented data systems, and entrenched ways of working are impeding the transition, according to the report.
